title: GitHub Universe 2026: Evolving every layer of the stack
content: GitHub Universe 2026 introduced an agentic software delivery platform centered on a new GitHub Copilot app. Key features include Copilot Fusion for multi-model orchestration, Copilot projects for parallel agent sessions, and cross-surface session continuity. The company also launched Copilot code review Max for high-severity bug detection and AI-powered automations that learn from outcomes. All Enterprise customers now access these features without separate subscriptions, utilizing AI credits. Additionally, GitHub is scaling its infrastructure with significant increases in CPU, storage, and network capacity, alongside a rearchitected Git system to handle growing agentic workloads.

title: Octoverse: Commits, pushes, reach new highs in 2026 as developers build with agents
content: GitHub’s Octoverse 2026 report reveals record developer activity, driven significantly by AI agents. Developers made 17.9 billion code pushes, while over 40% of pull requests now begin with agent drafts. The platform serves 225 million developers globally, with substantial growth in healthcare, agriculture, and mining. TypeScript remains the most used language, and 61% of users select multiple AI models per session. This surge in momentum reflects a shift toward agentic workflows, expanding GitHub’s reach into new industries and accelerating global developer adoption.
